translationRule: Preserve shipped semantics while translating factories, enhancer wrappers, descriptor names, and Text or Layer content to the approved JSX-era API.

obligations.claim: There is no DOM renderer, virtual DOM reconciliation, retained display list, style cascade, or speculative child render.
contradictions: CRC retains drawing commands in a virtual display list.

test.marker: invokes a plain function once with frozen author props and supports every existing hook

obligations.claim: A plain component therefore needs a definite allocation when it hides that subtree from its parent.
contradictions: A plain component can attach a platform measurement capability.

test.marker: reports plain functions as unsupported intrinsic measurement

obligations.claim: It cannot paint, invoke hooks, crcCanvasContext, crcLayoutBox, create targets/images/layers, schedule work, or acquire runtime resources.
contradictions: Measurement may invoke hooks and acquire runtime resources.

test.marker: isolates measurement from active render hooks and layout context

obligations.claim: The transparent policy does not give those targets DOM roles, accessible names, states, relationships, text selection, or screen-reader announcements.
contradictions: FocusManagement generates semantic DOM descendants and ARIA roles.

test.marker: installs the complete structural bridge and reports manager-backed render snapshots

obligations.claim: When meaningful information or operations exist only in Canvas pixels, the application must provide an equivalent semantic experience.
contradictions: CRC automatically provides the equivalent semantic experience.

test.marker: exports exactly the final runtime authoring surface

obligations.claim: A Canvas focus host and a simultaneously tabbable semantic alternative can create duplicate or invisible keyboard stops for the same operation.
contradictions: Both Canvas and semantic alternatives should always remain in the same Tab order.

test.marker: uses one forward and reverse Tab order across every native and logical stop

obligations.claim: The configuration belongs to the first live mount. Later crc() calls update the root node but do not replace the surface configuration or mount signal.
contradictions: An update may replace the live mount surface configuration.

test.marker: uses only the initial mount signal for an existing Canvas lifetime

obligations.claim: CRC derives the effective backing density from those rounded dimensions and installs one root transform before rendering.
contradictions: Components draw directly in unscaled physical backing pixels.

test.marker: renders a fixed viewport at the rounded backing density with contain

obligations.claim: Their public coordinate facades therefore report logical positions for every fit and density.
contradictions: Public pointer coordinates are physical backing-store coordinates.

test.marker: proves fixed density, responsive reflow, stable identity, and logical mouse coordinates

obligations.claim: none preserves the exact input. round, ceil, and floor snap opposite rectangle edges or the line coordinate using the effective stroke offset, preserving the signed span instead of adding one pixel.
contradictions: Pixel snapping adds an extra pixel to the span.

test.marker: leaves every rectangle value unchanged in none mode

obligations.claim: When wrap is true, wrapped lines accumulate without losing the final fitting line. An ellipsis box narrower than three dots resolves to an empty string.
contradictions: Wrapping may discard the final fitting line and always paints three dots.

test.marker: returns literal wrapped lines, baseline positions, and measured bounds

obligations.claim: Successful natural sizing uses naturalWidth and naturalHeight independently for whichever dimension is omitted. Pixel alignment produces one adjusted rectangle used by drawImage, the optional border, and the interaction path.
contradictions: Image drawing, border, and interaction use independently adjusted rectangles.

test.marker: expect(drawImage).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(image, ...expectedRectangle)

obligations.claim: On one persistent mount, a Layer invalidates and rerenders when its retained child root type/key, child props (including enumerable symbol keys), specified style, direct-child sequence, or layer dimensions change.
contradictions: A Layer cache ignores same-mount prop, child, style, and dimension changes.

test.marker: compares retained trees recursively and invalidates for prop, style, and child-sequence changes

obligations.claim: dispose() is synchronous and idempotent. config.signal and dispose() enter the same central disposal path.
contradictions: Repeated controller disposal may tear down a replacement mount.

test.marker: cancels immediate work and disposes a no-signal mount idempotently

obligations.claim: Reference counts still collapse all requesters to one actual Canvas listener per type.
contradictions: Every logical handler installs its own native Canvas listener.

test.marker: reference-counts one native listener and makes releases idempotent

obligations.claim: Removal during dispatch therefore remains effective, route additions wait for the next event, and one thrown handler cannot prevent later handlers or final cleanup.
contradictions: A thrown event handler aborts all remaining handlers and cleanup.

test.marker: reports a thrown handler and continues with unrelated handlers

obligations.claim: Each policy removes empty child values and requires exactly one remaining branded CRCElement. The policy does not paint, lay out, own hooks, or change the child's type, key, identity, parentage, measurement, paint order, or source order.
contradictions: Focus policies add a painted layout and identity wrapper.

test.marker: removes empties, recursively prepares one child, and preserves declaration order and child metadata

obligations.claim: Tab and Shift+Tab move through the source-order list and prevent the native default only when an internal next target exists.
contradictions: Tab navigation geometrically sorts targets and always wraps.

test.marker: uses one forward and reverse Tab order across every native and logical stop

obligations.claim: Target and ancestor key propagation -> focus-manager activation default -> nearest directional-boundary default.
contradictions: Keyboard defaults run before target propagation.

test.marker: keeps arrows in the nearest square boundary and gives target handlers precedence

obligations.claim: Remaining candidates compare this tuple in order: perpendicular-axis overlap before off-axis candidates; nearest forward edge distance; nearest perpendicular center distance; source index as the exact tie-breaker.
contradictions: Directional navigation chooses the nearest Euclidean center and ignores source order.

test.marker: uses the exact beam, forward-edge, perpendicular-center, and source tuple

obligations.claim: Iterables are required to be finite; infinite iterables are unsupported and CRC does not promise to detect them.
contradictions: CRC detects and safely terminates every infinite iterable.

test.marker: returns one frozen direct-element sequence from recursive container input

obligations.claim: overflow: clip clips paint and target geometry to the content box; it does not create scrolling.
contradictions: Every layout allocation clips overflow and enables scrolling.

test.marker: applies an optional child-space clip to paint and hit testing

obligations.claim: justifyContent flex-start default, flex-end, center, space-between, space-around, space-evenly. gap, rowGap, columnGap finite nonnegative numbers; axis values override gap; default 0.
contradictions: Flex gaps may be negative percentages and justifyContent defaults to center.

test.marker: requires explicit main-axis minimums and rejects unsupported values

obligations.claim: Fractional unit size is max(0, remaining) / max(1, totalFr), so a total fraction below one leaves unused free space.
contradictions: Grid normalizes every positive fraction total to consume all remaining space.

test.marker: leaves unused space when total fr is below one

obligations.claim: Measurement cannot call hooks, context accessors, observe a layout box, paint, register interaction targets, create image generations, or acquire runtime resources.
contradictions: Measurement may paint or consume the active component's hook slots.

test.marker: isolates measurement from active render hooks and layout context

obligations.claim: Enumerate interactive candidates in reverse paint order. The first hit wins. Earlier overlapping siblings do not receive the event.
contradictions: Mouse dispatch invokes every overlapping hit in forward paint order.

test.marker: loads the shared contract explorer and renders every approved case

obligations.claim: Exit always precedes entry, and every boundary transition precedes movement.
contradictions: Movement dispatches before exit and entry transitions.

test.marker: bubbles over/out and separately targets non-bubbling enter/leave nodes

obligations.claim: Without an explicit shared listener, no sibling-region click is emitted.
contradictions: Sibling regions always synthesize a click on both leaves.

test.marker: targets the deepest common live listener after down and up resolve to siblings

obligations.claim: Public coordinates are root-logical coordinates with fractional precision.
contradictions: Public coordinates are rounded Canvas backing pixels.

test.marker: projects root-logical coordinates and deltas, bubbles, and cancels natively

obligations.claim: Non-empty raw strings, nonzero numbers, Promises, async iterables, functions, symbols, foreign elements, and unsupported objects are contextual errors.
contradictions: Arbitrary raw values and Promises are silently ignored as children.

test.marker: rejects duplicate keys in one sibling scope after transparent flattening

obligations.claim: Ordinary traversal rejects duplicates during recursive child preflight with the public diagnostic <Receiver> received duplicate CRC key <key> as a CRC child.
contradictions: Ordinary traversal reports only Duplicate CRC key under parent.

test.marker: Host received duplicate CRC key "duplicate" as a CRC child.

obligations.claim: The latest explicit root wins; a state request cannot erase it, and parent-update intent is OR-preserved.
contradictions: The first queued root wins and state updates erase root replacement.

test.marker: does not lose a pending root replacement to a state update

obligations.claim: Every successful update must call the same number and kinds in the same order. Before reporting an omitted slot, CRC releases the abandoned slot's owned resources.
contradictions: Conditional hooks may change kind and count without remounting.

test.marker: releases an omitted hook resource, reports fewer hooks, and retries cleanly

obligations.claim: When measurement is nested during an active render, that isolation prevents attempted measurement hooks from consuming or reordering the parent component's hook slots.
contradictions: Nested measurement shares and advances the active parent's hook slots.

test.marker: isolates measurement from active render hooks and layout context

obligations.claim: Teardowns.execute() closes before it invokes a stable snapshot. A throwing entry is reported without preventing the remaining entries from running.
contradictions: Teardown stops at the first error and may execute the same entry twice.

test.marker: releases a stable snapshot once and isolates teardown errors

obligations.claim: A state setter is a capability belonging to the exact instance and exact component-ref object that created it.
contradictions: A stale state setter may update a replacement mount.

test.marker: cannot let a disposed mount setter update a replacement mount

obligations.claim: Each Image style.src change creates a new generation. Loaded state carries the source string; render ignores a loaded element whose source does not equal the current style.
contradictions: Late completion from a superseded Image source may publish and draw.

test.marker: draws only the current source when an older load callback arrives late

obligations.claim: Styles do not cascade or inherit. There are no selectors, stylesheets, specificity, ambient parent styles, computed DOM values, class names, variables, or media/container queries.
contradictions: Styles cascade and inherit through parent components.

test.marker: types optional and required specified style without exposing reserved program props

obligations.claim: Platform components defined with definePrimitive have three immutable stages: Specified: exact author input in the element props. Normalized: pure defaults and syntax expansion, independent of parent allocation. Resolved: allocation-aware, finite values supplied to the primitive renderer.
contradictions: Primitive renderers receive unresolved percentages directly from author props.

test.marker: normalizes, resolves percentages, and invokes the primitive renderer with program props

obligations.claim: Whitespace, suffixes, scientific notation, malformed strings, and non-finite results reject. Padding and gaps are finite nonnegative numbers, never percentages.
contradictions: Scientific notation, non-finite values, and percentage gaps are accepted.

test.marker: rejects non-finite numbers and malformed or unsupported strings

obligations.claim: A purely painted object is not an event target and does not occlude a registered target underneath it.
contradictions: Every painted object implicitly becomes an event target.

test.marker: freezes the DOM-aligned event vocabulary

obligations.claim: Target capture runs before target non-capture and both report phase 2. stopPropagation() completes the remaining handlers on the current node, suppresses later nodes/phases, and forwards to the native event.
contradictions: Target bubble runs before capture and stopPropagation skips the current node immediately.

test.marker: dispatches capture, target, and bubble in DOM path order

obligations.claim: Capture is per pointer ID. Subsequent coordinate pointer events route to that owner until explicit release, pointercancel, native loss, target removal, or root disposal.
contradictions: Pointer capture is global and survives target removal or root disposal.

test.marker: keeps capture ownership independent for two simultaneous pointer IDs

obligations.claim: Without that policy, native Canvas events in these families remain targetless and target handlers do not run. CRC exposes no separate public event-injection adapter or hidden editable DOM.
contradictions: A plain Canvas routes keyboard input to an implicit target and hidden editable DOM.

test.marker: routes native keyboard, focus, editing, and clipboard input only to Canvas observers without focus policy
